title: Scaling strategies for photonic neural networks
abstract:
Nature Reviews Physics, Published online: 29 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s42254-026-00984-z

Photonic neural networks promise fast, energy-efficient computing, but scaling them remains challenging by architecture-dependent trade-offs. This Review surveys spatial, temporal, spectral and informational scaling strategies across leading architectures, emphasizing insights into hybrid design and the future development of large-scale photonic computing.

title: Interplay of topology and reversible associations in multi-responsive macromolecular networks
abstract:
Nature Reviews Physics, Published online: 25 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s42254-026-00981-2

This Review presents a framework to understand and exploit the rheology of polymeric networks at different length and time scales, by critically comparing the linear and nonlinear response of branched macromolecules with that of associating networks possessing different types of bonds.
